newsitem.title: USA: Campbell says to resume share repurchases.
newsitem.headline: Campbell says to resume share repurchases.

text.p: Campbell Soup Co said in quarterly results it intended to resume share repurchases on the open market from Nov. 14, as part of a three-year, $2.5 billion buyback program announced in September.
The open-market purchases are to follow a "Dutch auction" portion of the buyback, which was completed Oct 10 and led to the acqusition of 13.5 million shares at $80 each, for a total of $1.1 billion.
Campbell spokesman Jerry Buckley declined to characterize the scale or schedule of the open-market purchase plans, other than to point to the overall board authorization for a three-year program.
